The agent received tool calls in a shape LangChain could not parse into structured messages. This is a known failure mode of the **langgraph-agent** strategy when the LLM, the OpenAI-compatible server, or a proxy in front of either of them produces non-standard tool-call responses.

**Try this:**
- **Bypass any proxy/shim** sitting in front of your local LLM server. Tool-call schema translation is the single most common place OpenAI-compatible proxies break, especially when they inject vendor extension fields (e.g. llama.cpp's `timings_per_token`, `return_progress`).
- **Update your serving stack.** llama.cpp has documented OpenAI tool-call format bugs (e.g. arguments emitted as object instead of JSON string). Recent builds of llama.cpp / vLLM / Ollama fix many of these.
- **Use a model with native tool-calling support.** Models without an explicit tool-call template fall back to generic prompting, which frequently produces unparseable outputs.
- **Switch strategy.** If you don't need an agentic loop, Settings → Search Strategy → **source-based** or **focused-iteration** sidesteps tool-calling entirely.
